findings.body:
chunk 1/2:

The guides contain concrete mismatches with this checkout, so the Done-when requirement's code verification remains incomplete. New evidence beyond the ruling to retain the guides: (1) 06-storage.md:81,87,362,389,480 and 09-identity-access.md:292,381 describe/link a remote-first skill wrapper and cache warming, but that module is absent and apps/core/src/adapters/storage/postgres/factory.ts:249 constructs S3SkillArtifactStore directly. Its getSkillArtifact implementation at apps/core/src/adapters/artifacts/skills/s3-skill-artifact-store.ts:113 reads S3 without warming that cache. (2) 06-storage.md:125 says unrouted messages use storeMessage, but apps/core/src/app/bootstrap/channel-persistence-handlers.ts:166–167 drops them before persistence. (3) 06-storage.md:158 describes GroupQueue as the scheduler execution admission queue, while apps/core/src/infrastructure/pgboss/scheduler-engine.ts:495–515 acquires durable slots and invokes runJob directly; apps/core/src/app/bootstrap/runtime-scheduler-start.ts:67 uses GroupQueue for process registration. (4) 02-runtime.md:203 cites the nonexistent src/session/session-command-parse.ts; the parser is in apps/core/src/application/sessions/session-command-parse.ts:8. Correct these current-system descriptions and references, then repeat the code/link check. Retaining the fourteen guides does not require retaining these inaccuracies.
